beats.say: You'd lose a race changing one tyre. An F1 crew changed all four in 1.8 seconds. How?
Qatar, 2023. McLaren, Lando Norris. 1.80 seconds. The fastest pit stop ever.
और इस हफ्ते F1 फिर से वहीं है, Qatar में।
beats.cap: And this week, F1 is back there. In Qatar.
lines: Lusail, where the record was set

beats.say: First secret: about twenty people. Every wheel gets three. One gun, one pulls the old tyre, one fits the new one.
Second: just one nut per wheel. And the gun spins at about nine thousand rpm.
तीसरा राज़: practice. हज़ारों pit stops, पूरे साल।
beats.cap: Secret three: practice. Thousands of pit stops, all year.

beats.say: सोचो, तीन साल बाद भी ये record कोई नहीं तोड़ पाया।
beats.cap: Think about it. Three years on, nobody has broken this record.

beats.say: Send this to the friend who takes twenty minutes to change one tyre.
lines: who takes 20 minutes for one tyre

beats.say: Pit crew or driver: who wins more races? One F1 secret every week. Follow for number three.
